title: ABOUT ME
content: Hey there! My name is Borodi Bogdan, but my closest friends call me Bob. I am a {age}-year-old student from Bistrita, Romania passionate about tech.
My journey into programming began during high school, sparking a fire within me for all things tech.

The first language programming i have ever used was C++, during informatics classes in high school. Since then, I explored several languages and technologies like C#, Python, 80x86 Assembly, React and so on.
Outside of coding, I'm passionate about sports and fitness. Music also holds a special place in my heart.

title: EDUCATION
content: I completed my secondary education at National College Liviu Rebreanu - Bistrița, where I distinguished myself with exceptional results, particularly in the field of informatics.
My academic performance and disciplined approach were recognized through a scholarship from CJ Bistrița-Năsăud, underscoring my commitment to excellence.
Currently, I am enrolled at Babeș-Bolyai University (BBU) in Cluj-Napoca, pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science.
I am proud to share that I rank among the top 10% of students in my faculty.

title: QPillars
content: QPillars played an important role in my growth as a software engineer. It was my first job, where I worked for six months learned a lot and met amazing people
I am especially grateful to my manager, Iacob, for trusting me and giving me this opportunity
• Refined UX by simplifying navigation and key workflows, boosting engagement across 2,000+ users.
• Improved backend data retrieval by implementing incremental fetching, reducing cutting data transfer time by ~85%.

title: Microsoft
content: I had the opportunity to intern at Microsoft from July to October 2025.
It was an amazing experience where I sharpened my technical skills and learned how to collaborate in a large team.
Here are some cool things I achieved here:
• Enhanced Microsoft’s internal AI assistant for on-call engineers, by integrating resilience data.
• Developed automation to correlate reliability signals (metrics, logs, and failure patterns), which streamlined incident triage.

title: EXTRA ACTIVITIES
content: Over the past three years, I have earned three medals in the prestigious National Olympiad of Informatics, showcasing my proficiency and expertise in the discipline.
Furthermore, I am deeply committed to sharing my knowledge and expertise with others. I am currently serving as a mentor and educator for Z-builders, where I teach students how to code in C++.
Grigore Moisil Scientific Committee Member - Contributed to Romanias prestigious informatics contest (30+ years) by designing problems, tests, and solutions.

title: SKILLS
content: Strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms.
Fluent in C++, C#, React, Python, 80x86 Assembly, and more.
Solid understanding of System Design, OOP, Regex, Multithreading, Concurrent Programming, LLMs, and RAG Systems.
Proficient English speaker with excellent communication skills.
Highly curious and passionate about exploring new technologies.
Strong social and teamwork abilities, with a natural drive to connect and collaborate.
